interactive.label: Guide
interactive.tooltip: Walk through choosing, editing and saving a setup.

interactive.label: Help
interactive.tooltip: Explain the page: setups, the reading routine, PIE windows, detectors, units of micro-time ranges and LUTs.

interactive.label: setup_choice
interactive.tooltip: Choose a saved detector setup; its detectors, PIE windows, reading routine, LUTs and optical setup replace the working definition.

interactive.label: Save
interactive.tooltip: Ask for a name and store the working definition as a saved setup.

interactive.label: Rename
interactive.tooltip: Give the selected saved setup another name.

interactive.label: Delete
interactive.tooltip: Delete the selected saved setup after asking.

interactive.label: Public
interactive.tooltip: When checked, the setup is visible to all users in the MMFDB; it takes effect with Save. Only the owner of a saved setup can change this.

interactive.label: calibration_choice
interactive.tooltip: Pick a stored calibration snapshot of the selected setup: its G factor, l1 and l2 are applied to the detectors. Latest leaves the factors as they are.
Explain the page: setups, reading routine, PIE windows, detectors and the units of micro-time ranges.

interactive.label: ▼ TTTR Reading routine
interactive.tooltip: File type, timing and binning used to read TTTR files.

interactive.label: tttr_format
interactive.tooltip: The TTTR container format used to read measurements; Auto detects it from the file.

interactive.label: Read
interactive.tooltip: Read a measurement or BH SET calibration: macro and micro time resolution from the header, and the decay of every routing channel.

interactive.label: macro_time_resolution
interactive.tooltip: Macro-time tick (the excitation period) in nanoseconds.

interactive.label: micro_time_resolution
interactive.tooltip: Micro-time channel width in picoseconds.

interactive.label: binning
interactive.tooltip: Number of original TAC channels per analysis bin.

interactive.label: effective
interactive.tooltip: Microtime resolution times the binning (read-only).

interactive.label: Plot
interactive.tooltip: Show or hide the micro-time decay preview with the PIE windows and detector gates overlaid.

interactive.label: ▶ PIE Windows
interactive.tooltip: PIE excitation windows (start and end TAC channel).

interactive.label: ▼ Detectors
interactive.tooltip: Detectors: routing channels, micro-time gates and polarization factors.

interactive.label: Polarization resolved
interactive.tooltip: ON: each detector's routing channels are interleaved parallel/perpendicular (VV/VH) for anisotropy. OFF: one unpolarized stream per detector.

interactive.label: Add
interactive.tooltip: Add a detector (channels 0, 1; range 0:2048) with a free name; rename and edit it in the table.

interactive.label: ▼ LUT handling (TAC linearization)
interactive.tooltip: TAC linearization tables and micro-time shifts per routing channel.

interactive.label: Apply TAC linearization (LUT) when reading
interactive.tooltip: When checked, each routing channel's assigned LUT linearizes the raw micro-times at read time (needed for e.g. SPC-130). If a used channel has no LUT, you are offered the LUT calculator.

interactive.label: Assign LUT...
interactive.tooltip: Assign a LUT file (.npy / .npz / .txt) to the selected channel row.

interactive.label: Configure LUTs...
interactive.tooltip: Open the LUT tools: compute a LUT from the loaded calibration decay (linear region or automatic), assign, export or remove it.

interactive.label: Adjust shifts...
interactive.tooltip: Visually align the per-channel micro-time shifts on the (LUT-corrected) calibration decay; read a calibration file first.

interactive.label: Optical Setup...
interactive.tooltip: Open the light-path editor: configure filters, dyes and detectors, and compute Foerster radii and cross-talk.
